nav.label: Main navigation
hero.lede: Capture, auto-crop, perspective correction, offline OCR and PDF archiving: one complete workflow. No dedicated scanner, and no uploads to the cloud.
hero.alt: UsbScan interface: live preview, document crop frame, page list and scan settings
meta.offline: All processing stays on your device
features.title: A camera workflow built for paper documents
features.lede: From framing to archiving, every step is designed for real document scanning, not just taking photos.
features.cameraDesc: Media Foundation as the primary backend with DirectShow fallback. Webcams, document cameras, industrial modules and built-in laptop cameras all work.
features.cropDesc: Document corners are drawn live on the preview. On capture, the background is cropped away and perspective distortion corrected; detection safely skips when uncertain.
features.ocrDesc: Uses your local Tesseract 5, with no network and no uploads. Results feed directly into searchable PDFs.
features.pdfDesc: Multi-page PDFs, single-page JPGs or whole-session exports, with file name and subfolder templates configured before capture.
features.uiDesc: A rounded interface drawn with Slint that follows the system light/dark theme; switches, toolbar and cards share one macOS visual language.
features.updateDesc: Choose whether to check for updates in the About window. When enabled, startup checks GitHub Releases and a new version can be downloaded and installed from the bottom-right corner.
workflow.title: Three steps to a finished scan
workflow.lede: No complex image editor to learn; most correction happens automatically when you capture.
workflow.s1Desc: Plug in any USB camera, then pick the device and resolution.
workflow.s2Desc: The preview shows the crop frame live; the shutter auto-crops, deskews and saves.
workflow.s3Desc: Rename, delete, run OCR, then export to PDF or JPG.
download.title: Download UsbScan
download.desc: The installer suits most users; the portable build runs after unzipping and writes no registry entries. The main button downloads the latest installer directly, and either build can be installed over an older version.
download.noteLoading: Reading the latest version… You can also browse all versions on GitHub Releases.
download.noteReady: You can install over an older version; checksums are listed in SHA256SUMS.txt.
download.noteIncomplete: This release does not include both the installer and portable build yet. See GitHub Releases for all assets.
download.noteUnavailable: No release has been published yet, or the GitHub API is unreachable. You can also check GitHub Releases for build artifacts.
download.vcRedist: UsbScan requires the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 Redistributable (x64). The installer detects it and offers a one-click install; portable users can download the runtime manually.
docs.title: Docs and source
docs.lede: Design, architecture, naming conventions and the release process are all public in the repository.
docs.designDesc: Requirements, architecture, UI prototypes and roadmap
page.title: UsbScan — Turn any USB camera into a document scanner
page.description: UsbScan is a Windows offline document scanning app: any UVC camera, auto-crop and perspective correction, offline OCR, PDF export and MP4 recording.
